target.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where DeepSeek and Xiaomi OpenAI-compatible users could lose provider prompt-cache hits after the 6.x boundary-aware cache split put per-turn dynamic context into the system prompt.

Closes #94518

Related: #91018, #90583

## Why This Change Was Made

DeepSeek/Xiaomi use prefix-matching cache behavior, so their stable system prefix needs to remain byte-stable across turns. This PR adds `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache`, defaults it on for those providers, keeps only the stable prefix in the system message, and moves the dynamic suffix into the latest user turn so older conversation history stays reusable.

Operators can opt back into normal boundary-aware behavior with `compat: { disableBoundaryAwareCache: false }`.

## User Impact

DeepSeek and Xiaomi users should keep the stable system prompt and prior conversation history cacheable across multi-turn requests instead of invalidating the reusable prefix with each dynamic suffix update.

## Evidence

Focused tests:

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/llm/providers/openai-completions.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  34 passed (34)
```

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  287 passed (287)
```

Non-test production request-building proof:

```bash
$ node --import tsx E:\Projects\auto-pr\workspace\openclaw\outputs\issue-94518\request-shape-proof.mts
{
  "model": "deepseek-v4-pro",
  "messages": [
    { "role": "system", "content": "Stable prefix" },
    { "role": "user", "content": "Historical request" },
    { "role": "assistant", "content": "Historical answer" },
    { "role": "user", "content": "Project Context\n\nCurrent request" }
  ]
}
```

Live DeepSeek cache proof:

```bash
$ node --import tsx E:\Projects\auto-pr\workspace\openclaw\outputs\issue-94518\deepseek-live-payloads.mts
"model": "deepseek-v4-flash"
"role": "system", "hasStablePrefix": true, "hasDynamicSuffix": false
"role": "user", "hasHistoricalUser": true, "hasDynamicSuffix": false
"role": "assistant"
"role": "user", "hasCurrentRequest": true, "hasDynamicSuffix": true
```

```bash
$ Invoke-RestMethod ... https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions
[
  {
    "label": "first",
    "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
    "prompt_tokens": 1987,
    "completion_tokens": 216,
    "total_tokens": 2203,
    "prompt_cache_hit_tokens": 1920,
    "prompt_cache_miss_tokens": 67
  },
  {
    "label": "second",
    "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
    "prompt_tokens": 1987,
    "completion_tokens": 209,
    "total_tokens": 2196,
    "prompt_cache_hit_tokens": 1920,
    "prompt_cache_miss_tokens": 67
  }
]
```

The live proof used `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` from the local environment. The key was not printed, saved in payload files, or written to the repository.
